/*-------------------------------
 Since the scroll is only by one month, two months on the displayed calendar remain
 unchanged. Only the position of these months is shifted on the screen which is achieved
 by calling the COPY_BLOCK_INFO program unit. The program accesses the database to decide
 the color of only one month, the one which was not displayed previous to this button-press.
----------------------------------*/

/*-- The new value of month1 gets set in populate_cal_days --*/

 last_day(to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY')),

ELSIF :change_view_opt.resource_view_change = 'IV' THEN

 last_day(to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY')),

 status_string);
ELSIF :change_view_opt.resource_view_change = 'DT' THEN
 Individual_Drive_Type(to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY'),
 last_day(to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY')),

ELSE

 last_day(to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY')),

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*-------------------------------------------
 This trigger attempts to minimize database access by following means :
 if scroll is for one month, the information for the existing two months in the calendar are just
 shifted to the proper block by using COPY_BLOCK_INFO. Database is accessed to decide status
 for one month only.
 if scroll is for two months, the information for the existing one month in the calendar is just
 shifted to the proper block by using COPY_BLOCK_INFO. Database is accessed to decide status
 for the other two months.
 If scroll is greater than or equal to three months, database is accessed for all three months.
 
 Also, if resource view mode is changed, database has to be accessed for all three months.
-----------------------------------------------*/

declare
 curmonth varchar2(6) ;
 scroll_months number ;
 status_string varchar2(2000) ;
 err_flag varchar2(1) ;
 err_msg varchar2(200) ;
begin
 if :change_view_opt.resource_view_change IN ('IS','IV','DC','DT') and :change_view_opt.view_selected is NULL then
 go_item('change_view_opt.view_select_value');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF :change_view_opt.resource_view_change IN ('IS','IV','DC','DT') and :change_view_opt.view_selected is NOT NULL then
 :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode := 'O';
 end if;


 if NVL(length(:change_view_opt.start_yr_change), 0) != 4 or :change_view_opt.start_mon_change is null then
 show_error('11118') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

 :view_mode_select.start_mon := :change_view_opt.start_mon_change ;
 :view_mode_select.start_yr := :change_view_opt.start_yr_change ;

 curmonth := :view_mode_select.start_mon||:view_mode_select.start_yr ;
 scroll_months := months_between(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY'));
 if :change_view_opt.resource_view_change != :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode then
 :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode := :change_view_opt.resource_view_change ;
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK1',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK2',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');

PROCEDURE populate_cal_days (curblk in VARCHAR2,yearmonth in VARCHAR2)IS
 FirstItemName varchar(60) ;
 Day VARCHAR2(3) ;
 TotDays number ;
 Counter number ;
 PrevItemName varchar2(80) ;
 FirstDay number(2) ;
 goal number(6) ;
 pdraw number(6) ;
BEGIN
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program unit populates the calendar. Explanation of inputs are :

 curblk : Block name which will be populated. Right now, only CAL_BLK1, CAL_BLK2 and 
 CAL_BLK3 are valid values.
 yearmonth : Month and year for which this block will be populated. yearmonth SHOULD BE 
 IN 'MMYYYY' format
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 go_block(curblk) ;
 clear_block ;
 init_properties(curblk) ;

 /* Get the first day of the month */
 Day := to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'DY') ;

 /* Get total number of days in the month */
 TotDays := to_number(to_char(last_day(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY')),'DD')) ;

 /* Go to the first item */
 FirstItemName := curblk||'.'||get_block_property(curblk,FIRST_ITEM);
 go_item(FirstItemName) ;
 if form_failure then
 message('Failed to go to first item,contact IS') ;
 end if ;


 /* Decide which item holds the first day of the month */
 if Day = 'SUN' then FirstDay := 1 ;
 elsif Day = 'MON' then FirstDay := 2 ;
 elsif Day = 'TUE' then FirstDay := 3 ;
 elsif Day = 'WED' then FirstDay := 4 ;
 elsif Day = 'THU' then FirstDay := 5 ;
 elsif Day = 'FRI' then FirstDay := 6 ;
 elsif Day = 'SAT' then FirstDay := 7 ;
 end if ;

 Counter := 1 ;

 while Counter < FirstDay loop
 next_item ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;

 Counter := 1 ;

 while Counter <= TotDays loop
 copy(to_char(Counter),:system.cursor_item) ;
 next_item ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
 
 /* Do not allow navigation to items which are not
 relevant to the current month */
 go_block(curblk) ;
 Counter := 1 ;
 go_item(FirstItemName) ;


 while Counter <= 35 loop
 if :system.cursor_value is null
 then
 PrevItemName := :system.cursor_item ;
 next_item ;
 set_item_property(PrevItemName,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 else
 next_item ;
 end if ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
 /* Do not allow navigation--- till here */

 if upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK1' then
 :month1 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname1 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month1,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal1 := goal ;
 :booked1 := pdraw ;
 elsif upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK2' then
 :month2 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname2 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month2,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal2 := goal ;
 :booked2 := pdraw ;
 elsif upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK3' then
 :month3 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname3 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month3,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal3 := goal ;
 :booked3 := pdraw ;
 end if ;

END;

PROCEDURE decode_status_string (curblk in varchar2,curmonth in varchar2,status_string in varchar2) IS
 status varchar2(5) ;
 curitm varchar2(80) ;
 counter number := 0; 
 next_delim_pos number ;
 start_pos number := 1 ;
 recruiter_drive_flag varchar2(1) ;
 caldate date ; 
BEGIN

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program decodes the status string returned by the DECIDE_DAY_STATUS stored program unit.
 Format of the string is as follows :
 10 characters of date field in 'MM-DD-YYYY' format followed by status value. ':' is used
 as delimiter.
 NOTE : If you are calling this function just once, then set GLOBAL.start_pos to '1' before the
 call. If you are calling this function more than once in a single scroll, which implies
 that you are scrolling by more than one month, then set GLOBAL.start_pos to '1' before the
 first call
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 start_pos := to_number(:global.start_pos) ;

 go_block(curblk) ;
 curitm := curblk||'.'||Get_Block_Property( curblk, FIRST_ITEM );
 go_item(curitm) ;

 while nvl(:system.cursor_value,'*') != '1' loop
 next_item ;
 end loop ;
--message(status_string);pause;
 loop
 next_delim_pos := instr(status_string,':',start_pos,1) ;
 caldate := to_date(substr(status_string,start_pos,10),'MM-DD-YYYY') ;
 recruiter_drive_flag := substr(status_string,start_pos+10,1) ;

 status := substr(status_string,start_pos+11,next_delim_pos-start_pos-11) ;
 start_pos := next_delim_pos + 1 ;
--message('yash..in decode_status_string--'||status);pause;

 if status = 'OPEN' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'LIMIT' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'YELLOW_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'YELLOW_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'BOOKD' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'RED_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'RED_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'CLOSD' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'BLUE_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'BLUE_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 else
 message('Invalid status on '||to_char(caldate,'MM-DD-RR')) ;
 end if ;
 
 if caldate = last_day(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY')) then
 exit ;
 else
 next_item ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 :global.start_pos := ltrim(rtrim(to_char(next_delim_pos+1))) ;
END;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'RR'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
